text:
Nia: Quick run-through for Hillcrest Meetup next Thurs — stage slot confirmed, we get a 6ft table. Need final swag list and the post-event lead flow by COB today.

Omar: Proposed swag: 300 stickers, 100 pocket guides, 60 insulated tumblers, 20 demo USBs with sample prompts. Tumblers are heavy but high value.

Claire: Love tumblers for brand recall but reduce to 40 to save shipping. Swap 20 tees in for variety.

Dex: Logistics update: crate pickup Fri 7am. Please finalize packing list by Thu 6pm. I pinned a packing spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/hillcrest-pack (edit).

Nia: Demo requirements: stable network or local fallback. Can we confirm 5G backup and a cached demo flow that runs offline? Also need a 30s social clip for Day0.

Omar: I'll rent a 5G router. We'll pre-cache prefixes and include a recorded fallback video. Social clip storyboard: 5s logo, 15s demo highlight (latency+cost overlay), 10s CTA to booth.

Claire: Postcard copy draft: headline "Predictable inference for product teams" + three bullets (latency, cost after batching, rollout safety). QR lands at /events/hillcrest and tags lead as hillcrest-24.

ops-bot: Reminder: post-event cadence template at /marketing/templates/post-event-cadence. Suggested: Day0 social, Day1 thank-you + slides, Day3 deep-dive, Day10 trial invite.

Dex: Packing manifest draft:
```
Crate A: 2x demo laptops, 1x 5G router, 1x switch, spare battery
Crate B: stickers x300, pocket guides x100, tumblers x40, tees x20
Crate C: USB demos x20, banners, chargers, tape
```

Nia: Routing: QR tag => HubSpot tag hillcrest-24 => owner SDR_Team_B. If form field interested==trial then immediately ping #sdr-urgent. Claire to set up HubSpot view.

Omar: Swag order placed (#HC-3344). ETA to office Mon.

Claire: I'll QA postcard copy and set up HubSpot routing. Dry run for demo Thu 4pm?

Nia: Dry run Thu 4pm works. Everyone sign off here so Ops can print labels.

Omar: Signed off on swag & social clip plan.

Claire: Signed off on copy & routing.

Dex: Signed off on packing manifest and courier pickup.
